title: The rat Micah Bell hid at camp in Red Dead 2
subject: micah
description:
When did you first suspect Micah? 👇

The informant inside the Van der Linde gang and how Arthur Morgan learned his name in Red Dead Redemption 2. Spoilers for Red Dead Redemption 2.

scenes.text: The man selling out Dutch's gang ate at its campfire.
By the end, the gang was hiding at Beaver Hollow, and Dutch trusted almost no one.
Micah kept telling him that Arthur and John were the real problem.
When John sat in Sisika Penitentiary, Dutch called a rescue too risky. Arthur and Sadie went anyway.
Then Pinkerton agent Andrew Milton cornered Arthur and Abigail, and he named the gang's informant.
It was Micah Bell. Abigail shot Milton seconds later.
Arthur rode back to camp with a name, and Dutch had to choose.
